# Peek Moment

> Safe, moderated random video chat with strangers from around the world. No profiles, no history. Meet real people, chat, play games, share moments.

## About

Peek Moment connects you with real people for spontaneous 1-on-1 video, audio, or text conversations. Every chat is moderated, and you can leave anytime with one tap.

## Features

- Random video chat with strangers worldwide
- Audio-only mode for privacy
- Text-only mode
- Region and language matching
- Live 1-to-many video rooms
- In-chat games and rewards
- 18+ only, moderated environment
